components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A compact midnight action for the next protocol or inspection step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #10233e); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ink, #10233e); color: var(--paper-bright, #faf7ed); font: 800 12px 'Covenant Sans', Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--cobalt-deep, #153f9f); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #2457ce); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Action
components.description: A paper action for secondary navigation and evidence inspection.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #10233e); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #10233e); font: 800 12px 'Covenant Sans', Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(16,35,62,.06); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #2457ce); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Verified Status
components.description: An explicit public-state label with mint ink and a precision frame.
components.css: .ds-status-verified { min-height: 31px; padding: 6px 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--mint, #247556); font: 800 9px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Evidence Field
components.description: A square monospaced field for addresses, amounts, blocks, and proof material.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink-faint, #566171); font: 800 8px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-field input { height: 46px; width: 100%; padding: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(16,35,62,.25)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #f3efe2); color: var(--ink, #10233e); font: 600 11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; outline: none; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #10233e); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--cobalt, #2457ce); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cobalt, #2457ce); }

components.name: Masthead Navigation Item
components.description: A restrained navigation cell separated by document rules.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--line-soft, rgba(16,35,62,.12)); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #43536a); font: 600 9px 'Covenant Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease-out, background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--cobalt, #2457ce); background: rgba(36,87,206,.04); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #2457ce); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-nav-item:active { background: rgba(36,87,206,.08); }

components.name: Serial Evidence Entry
components.description: An independently inspectable public record with a medallion, serial, label, and line icon.
components.html: AA-0001SEPOLIA PAYMENT TX
components.css: .ds-serial-entry { min-height: 74px; padding: 13px 15px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0,1fr) auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(16,35,62,.25)); background: var(--paper-bright, #faf7ed); color: var(--ink, #10233e); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-serial-entry:hover { color: var(--cobalt, #2457ce); background: rgba(36,87,206,.04); } .ds-serial-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #2457ce); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-serial-medallion { grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 27px; height: 27px; display: grid; place-items: center; align-self: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--cobalt, #2457ce); font: 400 15px 'Covenant Display', Georgia, serif; } .ds-serial-entry b { font: 800 11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-serial-entry > span:nth-of-type(2) { color: var(--ink-soft, #43536a); font: 700 9px 'Covenant Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-serial-entry svg { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; width: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Proof Stage
components.description: An engraved row for one causal event in the proof sequence.
components.html: 03CREDITCOIN VERIFICATIONCNative verifier call and evidence acceptanceINSPECT
components.css: .ds-proof-stage { min-height: 68px; padding: 7px 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px minmax(150px,1fr) 52px minmax(180px,1.15fr) 70px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-soft, rgba(16,35,62,.12)); background: rgba(250,247,237,.76); color: var(--ink, #10233e); text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-proof-stage:hover { background: rgba(36,87,206,.045); } .ds-proof-stage:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #2457ce); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-proof-stage b { color: var(--cobalt, #2457ce); font: 400 28px 'Covenant Display', Georgia, serif; } .ds-proof-stage strong { font: 800 13px 'Covenant Sans', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; } .ds-stage-rosette { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 3px double var(--mint, #247556); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--mint, #247556); font: 400 18px 'Covenant Display', Georgia, serif; } .ds-proof-stage small { color: var(--ink-soft, #43536a); font: 400 11px/1.35 'Covenant Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-proof-stage em { justify-self: end; color: var(--mint, #247556); font: 800 8px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Issued Proof Seal
components.description: The restrained oxblood authentication mark for a completed proof record.
components.css: .ds-proof-seal { width: 126px; height: 126px; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 1px rgba(70,20,28,.14)); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-proof-seal:hover { transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1.02); } .ds-proof-seal svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-proof-seal polygon { fill: var(--oxblood, #8a2636); stroke: var(--paper-bright, #faf7ed); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-proof-seal circle { fill: var(--paper-bright, #faf7ed); stroke: var(--oxblood, #8a2636); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-proof-seal path { fill: none; stroke: var(--oxblood, #8a2636); stroke-width: 1.4; }

narrative.overview:
COVENANT treats public protocol evidence as a financial instrument, not a dashboard. Warm security stock, engraved rules, serial notation, guilloche fields, a woven cobalt thread, and an oxblood verification seal give public records the visual weight of an issued document. The finish stays crisp and contemporary. Ornament always supports sequence, authenticity, or inspection.

The system leads with financial consequence and preserves a strict distinction between verified, pending, local, skipped, and rejected evidence. Large editorial type makes the causal claim readable. Compact sans-serif and monospaced labels carry technical detail, network state, serials, and status without competing with the proof story.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory security stock with midnight engraved structure.
A 30/70 editorial dossier and proof-instrument split on wide screens.
Cobalt threads and medallions express causal sequence.
Oxblood seals mark verification and rejection boundaries.
Mint indicates verified public state, with text labels beside every color state.
Real explorer links appear as serial ledger entries, never promotional cards.

rules.name: The Ink Economy Rule
rules.body: Cobalt describes evidence flow, oxblood describes consequence, and mint describes verified state. Do not use these colors as unrelated decoration.

rules.name: The State Needs Language Rule
rules.body: Every state color ships with an explicit label such as VERIFIED, REJECTED, PENDING, LOCAL, or SKIPPED.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for meaning and consequence. Use sans or mono for evidence, operation, and state.

rules.name: The Label Discipline Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels remain short. Full sentences belong in body text.

rules.name: The Continuous Instrument Rule
rules.body: Related proof, state, and evidence sections touch and share keylines. Do not split one causal record into detached cards.

rules.name: The Printed-First Rule
rules.body: Use rules, tone, and linework before shadow. Only the issued instrument and movable proof marks sit above the paper.

rules.name: The Geometry Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Rectangles hold records, circles authenticate them, and the vertical thread connects causality.

dos: **Do** lead public pages with one financial consequence and its causal proof record.
**Do** keep explorer links, transaction identifiers, contract state, and rejection evidence independently inspectable.
**Do** preserve explicit REAL, LOCAL, SKIPPED, PENDING, VERIFIED, and REJECTED language.
**Do** use authored SVG line icons, rosettes, guilloche fields, and seals.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, mobile reading order, and reduced-motion completion.
**Do** use ornament to clarify authenticity, sequence, or state.
donts: **Don't** convert evidence into dashboard tiles, rounded app cards, charts, token art, or generic crypto imagery.
**Don't** use gradients, glass effects, neon, photographic paper, or heavy vintage distressing.
**Don't** detach the serial ledger from the proof instrument it documents.
**Don't** use color as the only status signal.
**Don't** invent transaction state, financial performance, borrower behavior, or production-readiness claims.
**Don't** add motion without a causal or navigational purpose.
